goal: Get a 25 minute technical conversation with the Head of Payments or the engineer who owns checkout.

openers.multi_psp_detected: Noticed {{business_name}} runs more than one payment provider at checkout.
openers.new_market_launch: Saw {{business_name}} opened up in a new market recently.
openers.psp_outage_complaint: Saw the note about a provider outage hitting {{business_name}} checkout.
openers.checkout_conversion_post: Read what your team shared about checkout conversion at {{business_name}}.
openers.listing_only: {{business_name}} sells in enough places that payments is probably more than one vendor by now.

steps.subject: authorization rates
one question on checkout
the routing diagram
steps.body:
{{first_name}}, the fastest version: send me the list of providers and countries you process in, and I'll send back a one page routing diagram showing where retries and local methods would go. No call needed for that part.

{{sender_name}}
Call script: ask who owns checkout and whether auth rate is a tracked metric. Offer the routing diagram. If engineering, ask about integration time per new PSP today.

steps.subject: closing the loop
steps.body:
{{first_name}}, I'll leave it here. If auth rates or a new market come up, reply and I'll send the routing diagram over. Good luck with the quarter.

{{sender_name}}
